mythology: Sati's locks of hair (Kesha) fell on the Chamundi hills; here Goddess Durga incarnated as Chamundeshwari to slay the shape-shifting demon Mahishasura after a nine-day battle.
festivals: Mysuru Dasara (world-famous state festival with royal jamboo savari)
pilgrimage_significance: Guardian deity (Kuladevi) of Mysuru state and royal dynasty; premier Shakti sanctuary representing righteous triumph over demonic arrogance.
historical_notes: Mentioned in Devi Bhagavata Purana; patronized continuously by Karnataka dynasties including Ganga, Hoysala, Vijayanagara, and Wodeyars.
